claim: The UI's own selection is S = [[owner]+0x450]+0x20 (a Selection; loose land units: count [S+0x1c], UNIT*[] [S+0x20]). After BattleUI.SelectAllInfantry it lists exactly the 6 infantry UNIT pointers of the army list, the same pointers BattleUI.UnitListForBattleIds().Land hands out as Pointer<UNIT> userdata (the pointer is the userdata's first dword; Land lists the player's army first, then the enemy). So C++ reads S directly; the cards route was not needed
notes: runs b1 to b3 (raw/b3_units_select.txt); orders build their own one-unit selection, never the UI's
